components.name: Slot
components.description: A blank, fixed-size placeholder with no visual style of its own. Its sole purpose is to receive a component swapped into it.

properties.name: component swap
properties.notes: Use the component swap property to replace the Slot with the desired component (icon, avatar, badge, image, etc.).

rules: Slots are used directly in layouts — place the Slot component, then swap a component inside it.
Use the component swap property to replace the Slot with the desired component (icon, avatar, badge, image, etc.).
A Slot has no visual output on its own — it inherits entirely from the swapped component.

components.name: Slot Container
components.description: Wraps a Slot inside a structural layer. It manages structural layout and is never the final drop target.
rules: Slot Containers are never placed or used directly in a layout as a content target.
To add content: double-click into the container, navigate inside, select the Slot, then swap the component inside the Slot.
The container manages structural layout. The Slot inside it manages the content.
Never swap content directly onto a Slot Container — always go one level deeper to the Slot.

components.name: Icon Wrapper
components.description: The container that sizes and renders every icon. Always place icons inside a wrapper rather than dropping raw icon components directly into layouts. Display-only.

properties.name: Wrapper Size
properties.notes: Icon size inside matches the wrapper size (e.g. 16px wrapper = 16×16 icon). Default is 24px. Never manually resize a raw icon — always use a wrapper size from the table.

variants.name: 16px
variants.semantic_use: Inline with small text, compact list rows, tag suffixes

variants.name: 24px
variants.semantic_use: Default — app bar, section rows, input fields, standard buttons

variants.name: 28px
variants.semantic_use: Slightly emphasised — section headers, feature labels

variants.name: 32px
variants.semantic_use: Medium emphasis — card headers, onboarding steps

variants.name: 40px
variants.semantic_use: Touch target — tappable icon actions (see Icon Button)

variants.name: 48px
variants.semantic_use: Large emphasis — empty states, hero spots, UPI app logos

rules: Always place icons inside a wrapper — never drop raw icon components directly into layouts.
Use Icon Button (not Icon Wrapper) wherever the icon is tappable.
Icon Wrapper is display-only. Icon Button provides the correct 40px touch target.
Never manually resize a raw icon — always use a wrapper size from the table.
Missing icon? Use Icons/placeholder as a temporary stand-in and replace it once the correct icon is added. Never use a random icon as a substitute.
Apply colour via token, never hardcoded (e.g. token('icon/primary')).

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: The tappable variant of the Icon Wrapper. It provides a 40px touch target and is used wherever an icon triggers an action.

properties.name: Count
properties.notes: Number of icon actions. Width scales with count: 1=40px, 2=86px, 3=132px, 4=178px.

variants.name: Count = 1
variants.semantic_use: Single icon action — close, share, more

variants.name: Count = 2
variants.semantic_use: Two icon actions side by side — share + bookmark

variants.name: Count = 3
variants.semantic_use: Three icon actions — app bar trailing group

variants.name: Count = 4
variants.semantic_use: Four icon actions — full action row

rules: Use Icon Button (not Icon Wrapper) wherever the icon is tappable.
Icon Button provides the correct 40px touch target; Icon Wrapper is display-only.
Tappable icon? Use Icon Button, not Icon Wrapper.
